stories.headline: Why elevated borrowing costs constrain public budgets
stories.summary: Government debt-service costs can limit the fiscal response to new economic shocks. The key issue is how real borrowing costs compare with economic growth.
stories.why: A country can experience GDP growth and still lose fiscal space.

stories.headline: Can smaller AI models help close productivity gaps?
stories.summary: Localized AI tools could reduce information frictions in agriculture and public services.
stories.why: Adoption and complementary infrastructure determine the returns to new technology.

stories.headline: The economics behind energy sanctions
stories.summary: Restricting commodity exports can affect both quantities and world prices.
stories.why: The incidence of sanctions depends on supply, demand and trade diversion.

stories.headline: AI infrastructure changes the investment equation
stories.summary: Large up-front capital costs and uncertain future revenues shape investment in computing infrastructure.
stories.why: Social gains from innovation and private profits can diverge.

stories.headline: RCTs do not automatically identify every treatment effect
stories.summary: Randomization identifies effects of assignment, but conditioning on participation needs more assumptions.
